== Composed 2017 primary source ==
[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 18. Original rectangle <code>[397.7340087890625, 46.343994140625, 576.6060180664062, 128.0159912109375]</code>, background xref 373, occurrence 7. Actual composed vector text/icons are retained.

The sheet edition and repository imports identify preserved source occurrences; they do not establish unknown first-publication days. In particular, the full face in the initial 2018 import may predate that import, so its original first-publication order relative to the 2017 partial is not independently established. The dated occurrences therefore do not independently settle their original publication sequence.

Printed fields: power1, ability2, deployasterisk, forfeit1, Warrioricon, game text, E. Verified uncovered fields: titleHetNkik, unique dot, destiny3, Jawa scout lore, ANHexpansionmark. No new playable ID is assigned. Existing historical ID fields are inherited without a loader-support claim. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
